decision_rationale: The selected text explicitly says this is a “perspective” that “reviews the development and applications of foundation models in transcription regulation,” so it is a review/editorial rather than a primary model paper. The evidence centers on genomic inputs like DNA and epigenomic data; no substantive natural-language text-bio bridge or specific generative architecture is described.
evidence_snippet: “This perspective reviews the development and applications of foundation models in transcription regulation” / “input genomic data, such as DNA sequences and epigenomic or transcription factor binding information” / “leveraging pre-trained large language models and transfer learning” / “multi-modal models” / “This perspective ...”
